newsitem.title: USA: Coke Ent expects EC merger statement end-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Coke Ent expects EC merger statement end-Nov.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said Tuesday it expects a European Commission merger task force to issue a "Statement of Objections" to a proposed acquisition of Amalgamated Beverages Great Britain Limited before the end of November.

The statement could, under some circumstances, result in modifications to the terms of the transaction to resolve issues raised by the staff, Coca-Cola said in a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
However, Coca-Cola said it is unable to predict what effect the modifications may have upon the proposed transaction.
The company remains confident the transaction will ultimately be approved and completed, the filing said. Coca-Cola and other parties to the proposed acquisition will respond to the statement.
Amalgamated owns British bottler Coca-Cola & Schweppes Limited (CCSB).

In mid-September, the Commission began a second stage probe into Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc's acquisition under the European Union's merger regulations. The Commission has until Jan 29, 1997 to make a final decision.
